description: A small round zen garden tray filled with white sand sits on the table, with a tiny gray figurine and a smooth stone inside, and a small yellow rake nearby. The left hand stays mostly still to the left of the tray, while the right hand holds the yellow rake as a right-hand object and drags it along the sand near the tray’s right edge, smoothing and refreshing the wavy grooves, then lifts and repositions the rake and rakes again closer to the figurine.
